GROK 4.5 LEADS ON REAL PROFESSIONAL WORK BENCHMARK

New data from Snorkel shows Grok 4.5 outperforming other frontier models on real-world professional tasks.

On their GDPval+ benchmark (expert-created workplace reasoning tasks across the economy):

•  Grok 4.5: 29% mean pass rate
•  GPT 5.5: 22%
•  Claude Opus 4.8: 21%
Grok 4.5 showed particularly strong gains in demanding areas like legal work, education, healthcare, and QA analysis.

This lines up with xAI’s focus on building models that excel at practical, agentic work rather than just synthetic benchmarks.
While general intelligence leaderboards still see tight competition at the very top, Grok 4.5 is delivering some of the strongest results on actual professional deliverables right now.




Elon Musk (@elonmusk)

GROK 4.5 TAKES #1 AMONG NON-ANTHROPIC MODELS ON NEW AGENTIC BENCHMARK
According to Artificial Analysis, Grok 4.5 ranks as the top non-Anthropic model on their new AA-Briefcase benchmark.
This test evaluates real-world agentic knowledge work — handling complex, multi-week professional projects with thousands of files to deliver reports, analysis, spreadsheets, and presentations.
Key highlights:
•  Highest Elo score among non-Claude models
•  Strong performance on correctness and analysis
•  Significantly cheaper ($1.12 per task) and faster than top competitors
While Anthropic models still lead overall on some general benchmarks, Grok 4.5 is delivering the best practical agentic performance outside of Claude right now — at a much better price.

BREAKING: Tesla dominated the Swiss auto market in June. 🇨🇭

The Tesla Model Y was the country's best-selling vehicle, leading all brands and powertrains.

• Model Y ranked #1 overall
• Sales more than doubled year over year
• Tesla registrations climbed 78.6%
• Tesla secured a 6.3% share of the total market

Another milestone as Tesla's growth across Europe continues.

BREAKING: SpaceX just shattered its first-half Starlink launch record. 🚀

The company deployed 1,589 Starlink satellites during the first half of 2026, surpassing the previous H1 record of 1,489 set in 2025.

At its current pace, SpaceX is also on track to exceed its full-year Starlink launch record, continuing its rapid expansion of the world's largest satellite constellation.

BREAKING: Zimbabwe's Junior Parliamentarians have received Starlink kits. 🇿🇼

The Starlink terminals were handed over by President Emmerson Mnangagwa to help improve internet access and expand digital learning opportunities for Junior Parliamentarians.

Another step toward bringing reliable connectivity to the next generation.

Excited to share my experience with the Urtopia Carbon Fold e-bike that I recently assembled.

As a 6'1", 240 lb rider, this ultra-light carbon folder (~32 lbs) hits the mark. It folds compact for easy storage and transport, delivers smooth torque-sensor assist from the 250W motor, and offers a comfortable fit with solid range for commuting or breaks at a Supercharger.

The torque-sensing pedal assist paired with the 250W motor (peaking at 500W) provides smooth, responsive power that handles real-world riding with ease. The step-through frame offers a solid, comfortable fit, while the integrated battery delivers reliable range.

Whether you’re seeking a premium folding e-bike for daily use, travel, or adding efficient electric daily, the Urtopia Carbon Fold stands out as a thoughtful blend of lightweight design, build quality, and capability.

Highly recommended for anyone prioritizing convenience and performance in a compact package.

#Urtopia #CarbonFold #FoldingEBike #LightweightEBike #ElectricBike
